resources.string: Check the username and password with your proxy provider, then edit the profile.
This proxy only offers a sign-in method ProxyFlow doesn\'t support. Ask your provider for Basic sign-in, or use a SOCKS5 proxy.
The proxy\'s certificate didn\'t pass the check. Check the server name in the profile, or ask your provider for a valid certificate. ProxyFlow never skips the check.
Check your phone\'s date and time. If they\'re right, the proxy\'s certificate has expired: contact your provider.
The proxy didn\'t complete TLS. Check the port, and whether your provider offers TLS on it. ProxyFlow never falls back to an unencrypted connection.
The proxy\'s address wasn\'t found. Check its spelling in the profile, or use its IP address.
The proxy accepted the connection but didn\'t answer in time. Try again later, or check with your provider.
Check the address and port in the profile, and that the proxy is online.
Check the protocol (HTTP or SOCKS5) and the port in the profile.
This HTTP proxy doesn\'t allow tunnels (CONNECT). Check the port, or ask your provider for a proxy that allows them.
Your proxy couldn\'t reach some sites or refused them. Other connections are unaffected. If it goes on, check with your provider.
Your proxy refused to open a test connection. Providers answer this way when a plan has ended or your network\'s address isn\'t allowed. Check your account with your proxy provider.

Your proxy accepted the connection but couldn\'t open a test connection to connectivitycheck.gstatic.com. The proxy may have no internet access right now, or it blocks that address. Check with your proxy provider.
Your proxy answered the test connection with an error. Check your account with your proxy provider.
Your proxy doesn\'t support the connections ProxyFlow needs: tunnels to a site by its name. Use another proxy, or ask your provider.
An app used an address from before this connection; it tries again on its own. Nothing to do.
ProxyFlow reached its connection limit, so new connections were refused until others closed. If it goes on, close apps you aren\'t using.
An app gave up before its connection was ready. Nothing to do unless it goes on.
One connection hit an internal error and was closed. Other traffic is unaffected.
ProxyFlow reconnects when your phone has a network again. Apps stay paused meanwhile.
Restart the connection from Home. If it happens again, export this log for support.
Enter the password again in the profile.
Android started ProxyFlow as your Always-on VPN, but no proxy was chosen. Connect once from Home with the proxy Always-on VPN should use.

Android removed the VPN with ProxyFlow\'s process: apps used your normal network until ProxyFlow connected again, unless Android\'s system kill switch was on. Set it up in Settings, System kill switch.
Another VPN app was turned on, or ProxyFlow\'s VPN permission was removed. Reconnect from Home.
Connect again from Home. If it happens again, export this log for support.
Connect again from Home and allow Android\'s VPN request. If another VPN app is set to Always-on, turn that off first.
The profile this connection used was deleted, so its proxy isn\'t used any more. Stop the connection from Home, then connect with another profile.
